profile.headline: Software Engineer I @ Intuit
profile.summary:
The first thing I ever deployed crashed within an hour. The second one stayed up. Somewhere between those two, I figured out I wanted to do this for a living.
 
I'm graduating from NJCU this May with a CS degree and a few years of building real systems behind me, serverless backends on AWS, real-time messaging with Socket.io and Redis, Infrastructure-as-Code on GCP with Terraform, and ML models in PyTorch optimized to run on edge devices. Not toy projects: things with users, uptime requirements, and the occasional 2 AM debugging session.
 
I'm strongest in backend and full-stack work (Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, AWS/GCP) but I've done enough across the stack, frontend, mobile, ML, DevOps, to know what I don't know and to learn it quickly.
 
Looking for new-grad software engineering roles. Backend, full-stack, cloud, or AI/ML, open to all of them.
 
📧 Patelswyam80@gmail.com

projects.title: Audio Security Monitor - AI-Powered Sound Classification
projects.description:
• 🎯 Real-time audio event classification system with 85%+ accuracy detecting 10 sound categories including security threats
• Built with TensorFlow/Keras CNN (ML Model) & React.js (Frontend) & Flask (Backend)
• Trained on UrbanSound8K dataset with 8,732 audio samples
• Processes WAV, MP3, OGG formats in under 1 second with confidence scoring
• Deployed on Vercel/Railway for instant global accessibility
• Live Demo: https://real-time-audio-event-classificatio.vercel.app/
• Open Source: https://github.com/swyampatel/Real-time-Audio-Event-Classification

projects.title: AI Runner Game
projects.description:
🎮 AI Runner Game is an interactive endless runner game powered by AI-based difficulty adjustments.
 • Built with React.js (Frontend) & FastAPI (Backend).
 • Uses WebSockets for real-time score tracking.
 • Works seamlessly on mobile & desktop.
 • Live & Open Source – Try it out today!
